article.title: Clasificador par: 켤레
article.chapter: Números, clasificadores, hora y fecha — 수사·단위명사·시간·날짜

claims.summary: The NIKL response quotes the Standard Korean Language Dictionary definition of 켤레 as counting two corresponding items as one set, and explicitly gives 장갑 한 켤레 and 양말 두 켤레; it distinguishes this from 짝 for one individual item.

locator.source: National Institute of Korean Language, Online Q&A, “물건을 세는 단위,” answer dated 2026-02-28
locator.detail: Answer §3 quotes the Standard Korean Language Dictionary: 켤레 counts two corresponding items such as shoes, socks, or beoseon as one set; it gives 장갑 한 켤레 and 양말 두 켤레. It contrasts 짝 as counting each of the two corresponding items separately and later states 양말 한 짝 means one sock.

links.notes: La ficha se corrigió con la definición citada del diccionario normativo, ejemplos oficiales y contraste con 짝; se retiraron las afirmaciones generales no cubiertas.
